injuries.detail: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
Wade (hamstring) won't play Saturday against the Bucks.
Bona (back) participated in Friday's practice, though he still needs to go through a full practice with contact before being cleared to return to game action, A
Brown (hamstring) went through individual work during Friday's practice, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
